authentication: Normal Cognito Authorization Code + PKCE; each run revoked its own session (HTTP 204)
decision: D-17 (owner, 7 October 2026): only the organisation's platform admins change the four organisation-wide settings; event Chiefs and Admins read them.

editorRelease.note: Refusal-only. The staging smoke identity is a platform admin (canChange true), so no non-admin refusal was exercised on staging; that path is covered by integration tests. No organisation setting was changed on staging.

checks.copied: none: staging had no legacy override; all four keys stay defaults at version 0

harnessNotes: The first run looked for the refresh cookie at the API root; the cookie is scoped to /api/v1/auth. The lookup was corrected and the run repeated.

The second run's access-log check waited 20 seconds and saw the device preflight (204) and the anonymous read (401) but not yet the device GET; a later query found it with status 200 and integrationStatus 200. Log delivery latency, not a product failure.

ordering: The reader release was pushed only after the editor image was the single running task.
limitations: Only eventName is still written to the legacy store, and nothing else reads it. AppSetting is not dropped. P10.8 and G3 remain open.
